content:
Ravi: Morning all — quick sync: ran infra perf runs on the batching service overnight; saw ~8% tail latency improvement. Blocker: canary in eu-west-1 (svc-nyx) is OOMing. Plan is to run a smaller memory profile and retry this afternoon. Ping @Lina for kernel flag help.

Lina: Thanks — will look at kernel flags. Can you paste the failing pod logs?

Ravi: pasted logs below:
```json
{"error":"OOMKilled","pod":"nyx-canary-7"}
```

Lina: I see peak ~14GB usage, could be a KV cache leak. I'll add a temporary metric alert and capture a heapdump on the next repro. @Ava can you hold off on rollback until we verify?

Ava: Holding — I'm also pushing a small patch to skip prefetch on short sequences (should cut mem spikes). CR: #3284, can reviewers please take a look? @Chris @Miguel

Chris: reviewing now, should be quick. One nit about a log line but LGTM otherwise.

Miguel: will review after lunch. FYI blocked on infra approval for dedicated nodes quota — @Ravi, do you have the ticket number?

Ravi: ticket INC-7821, submitted last night. Ops estimated ~4hr ETA.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service 'nyx' in eu-west-1 by Ava — deploy id dpl-9932

Ava: thanks @deploy-bot — note: if canary fails we have auto-fallback to v2.3.2. Reminder: all-hands at 2pm — please drop any blockers in here before 1:45.

Chris: small FYI — left a docs note about batching config defaults. Link: https://redwood.dev/docs/batching#defaults

Miguel: update — infra approved the quota early, no longer blocked. I'll watch the canary metrics and stand by for rollback.

Lina: I'll run heap dump instructions if OOM reproduces; adding alert threshold at 12GB for now :warning:

Ava: Plan: 1) wait for quota, 2) rerun canary with patch, 3) monitor 30m, 4) rollback if OOM. Anyone object?

Chris: no objections. :thumbsup:

Miguel: no objections. Ping me if you need a manual rollback.

Ravi: updating incident board: https://redwood.incidents/nyx-oom-1948543210
